items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: His musicality has enabled him to support singers like Joe Williams

ctx.x: Drummer Eddie Metz Jr. has played with a lengthy list of jazz luminaries, from Steve Allen to the Count Basie Orchestra. His musicality has enabled him to support singers like Joe Williams and Sammy Davis Jr. and to co-lead a trio with bassist Nicki Parrott and pianist Rossano Sportiello. He records frequently for Arbors Records and engages in teaching future musicians at a jazz camp during the summertime.
Eddie was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on October 3, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
